# AstroDeck

> Open-source Astro starter kit for AI-assisted websites. Company sites, blogs, portfolios, and landing pages built with Claude Code, Cursor, or any coding agent — on guarded design rails (AGENTS.md conventions, a convention guard hook, one OKLCH design-token system, and one-command quality checks). MIT licensed.

AstroDeck is a normal, well-documented Astro 7 + Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui project. Every task in the docs is shown two ways: with an AI assistant and manually. Conventions live in AGENTS.md (the AGENTS.md standard), project-specific overrides in PROJECT.md.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://astrodeck.dev/docs): Getting started, building blocks, creating pages and sections, theming, blog posts, deployment, AI architecture, quality gates, project structure
- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://astrodeck.dev/llms-full.txt): AGENTS.md conventions plus the README in one plain-text file
- [Changelog](https://astrodeck.dev/changelog): Release history

## Building blocks

- [Sections](https://astrodeck.dev/sections): 16 page sections (Hero, HeroGradient, HeroSplit, Features, Pricing, FAQ, Testimonials, Team, Stats, CTA, Contact, Newsletter, LogoCloud, Comparison, ContentBlock, AIFeature)
- [Components](https://astrodeck.dev/components): 11 shadcn/ui React components (Button, Card, Badge, Input, Label, Accordion, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Select, Tabs, Tooltip)
- [Pages](https://astrodeck.dev/pages): Example pages and templates (SaaS, startup, portfolio, contact, blog, login, 404)
- [Component registry](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck/blob/main/src/registry.json): Machine-readable catalog of every section, component, and layout with props

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck): Source code, issues, releases
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Conventions for AI coding assistants
- [Latest release](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck/releases/latest): Download
